method: Read each original Stage1 interpretation alongside the requirement and proposition definitions; independently assessed meaning before inspecting draft canonical groups, then reviewed every draft canonical, member index and explanation. No aggregation results used to make group decisions. Stage2 additions excluded.
review_principles: Each original remains one whole unit; no decomposition of combined or ambiguous readings into extra votes.
Preserve explicit trigger quantification, current/initial reference, same-step/strict-later/next-step boundaries, simultaneity and onset, stopping/endpoints, release liveness and no-event vacuity.
An explanatory fragment cannot inherit missing obligations or timing from sibling interpretations or proposed readings.

Merge genuine logical equivalences such as independent eventual events and finite joint completion, first/every activation permanent suffix, and after-first-pulse vs at-or-after-second in a consecutive pair.
Maintain stable IDs; retired empty IDs are not recycled. Count distinct model identities, not paraphrase count.
